card.name: Verbs and particles before an object
card.fires_on: Small verbs and particles such as on, for, sent, in, enabled, hold, host that follow a verb and come just before a noun phrase object. Mostly general web prose, not drug text.

modes.label: Particle after verb
modes.description: A preposition or particle following a verb like put or sent, before its object.

modes.label: Verb before object
modes.description: A verb such as sent, hold or host that is about to take a noun object.
modes.example: Allah has<< sent>> down both the disease and the cure,
